infobox.usage: Unlocks the gas station storage closet door on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gas station storage room key (Gas Store) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the storage room inside one of the gas stations.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - 1 needs to be found for the quest Aid Stations

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: - Under the desk in the new gas station office.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The first room on the right in the hallway inside the new gas station on Customs.
